generative_review.domain_specificity_oracle: A route must speak in Yang-Mills terms such as H_YM, Omega, spectral measure, Schwinger functions, OS/reflection positivity, gauge-invariant observables, connected cumulants, continuum limit, and cutoff uniformity.
generative_review.summary: The validation probes separate typed structure from mathematical interpretation. The valid no-gap route is accepted only as a proof obligation because observable density, spectral support, and cutoff-uniform decay remain to be proved. The bad fixtures are not merely schema failures: cross-cutoff contradiction is quarantined, overstrong negation is repaired, and missing OS-positivity closedness becomes an evidence-acquisition task.

items.derived_consequence: If the negative continuum form exists while all approximating reflection forms are nonnegative and the cone is closed, the limit would both belong and not belong to the OS-positive cone.

This is proof-system boundary progress and not evidence for P != NP.

cycle_summaries.blocking_gap: The bridge does not reach NP notin P/poly unless one proves a cofinal family of padded lower bounds or finds a non-artificial carrier whose interface compresses every polynomial target exponent below N^{1+epsilon}.

control_decision.pivot_test: If no named carrier preserves an O(N+N^{c/k})-type interface for arbitrary c, quarantine this branch as padding-only magnification.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote when a source lower bound at N^{1+epsilon} is proved for cofinally many k values or a nonpadded meta-complexity carrier compresses every P/poly exponent below the threshold.
control_decision.reason: A valid bridge lemma was obtained, but it exposes a fixed-k ceiling. Continue only if the next experiment replaces artificial padding by a carrier such as MKtP/GapMCSP or proves a cofinal k-family.

cycle_summaries.mathematical_learning: The exact quantitative transfer is C(Pad_k(SAT)_N)<=O(N+N^{c/k}); hence the barely-superlinear lower bound magnifies only up to target exponent k(1+epsilon). The valid bridge is useful as an exponent-calibrated route lemma, while the fixed-k P/poly claim is blocked by a concrete threshold falsifier rather than by vague folklore.

Thus black-box formula-style P/poly repair is quarantined; progress now requires a genuinely nonblackbox carrier or a proof object where target circuits are used without independent short-query lookup.

discovery_marathon.purpose: Track the long-horizon recursive run as durable branch memory, cycle learning, skill-dispatch traces, deep reviews, and controlled promotion decisions. This is the operational layer that lets discovery run for hours while preserving the target spine and avoiding low-value drift. The What Actually Changed section separates mathematical learning from workflow bookkeeping.
discovery_marathon.title: Discovery Marathon
what_actually_changed: The marathon created durable branch-local mathematical memory.
Each cycle produced theorem-shaped branch outputs with equations, assumptions, falsifiers, and next experiments.
Skill dispatch is now explicit and validated rather than implicit in a workflow name.
Completed subgoal enablement is now explicit: completed or near-completed subgoals are interpreted by the gate they open for the larger target, not by completion alone.

Literature-gap preinvestment is now explicit: broad branch exploration needs a validated avenue warrant with closest-known-result accounting, novelty boundary, field impact, unification power, and route-decision power.
Field relevance and general impact are now explicit: local route work is support-only unless it names a target carrier, target gate, unification-power payoff, and demotion-ready impact test.
Visual conceptualization is now controlled: metaphors must preserve named theorem properties, expose distortions, and generate an audited route consequence before affecting proof search.
Research cycle count is 154; synthetic smoke/legacy packet count is 0.

decision_criteria.quarantine: Hold the idea as visible evidence or analogy when it is illuminating but lacks target-object identity, transfer certification, source grounding, or essential-commitment preservation.
decision_criteria.stop: Stop spending active-loop budget when the subgoal has no meaningful target-object link or fails to generate new learning after repeated attempts.

anti_drift_rules: Do not count Hamiltonian notation as progress unless the Hilbert space comes from the reconstructed continuum Yang-Mills theory.
Do not count Euclidean decay as progress unless constants survive cutoff removal.
Do not count RG ultraviolet control as progress toward the gap unless it connects to OS-positive Schwinger functions and a mass-gap witness.
Do not split construction, nontriviality, and spectral gap across different regulated theories.
Do not count a reductio branch as progress unless its exact negation, carrier, and conflict target preserve the same Yang-Mills object.
interpretative_strategy_story.current_thesis: The physical story is about whether fluctuating non-Abelian gauge fields can be controlled across scales so that the continuum limit still contains an interacting gauge-invariant vacuum sector, and whether the Euclidean time correlations of that same sector have spectral support bounded away from zero. Balaban-style RG is the ultraviolet and continuum-construction spine; OS/reflection positivity is the passage from Euclidean Schwinger data to a Hilbert-space energy operator; correlator decay is the infrared spectral witness. The Hamiltonian gap statement is therefore the endpoint of this chain, not an object that may be postulated independently.
interpretative_strategy_story.mode: generative interpretative strategy, not route-index prose
physics_explanation_contract: Name the dynamical object: four-dimensional compact simple Yang-Mills gauge-field configurations, their gauge-invariant observable algebra, and the vacuum sector being constructed.
Explain the scale story: which ultraviolet cutoff, infrared volume, and coarse-graining or continuum-limit passage is being controlled.
Name the observables that carry physical information, such as Wilson loops, local curvature composites, or gauge-invariant Schwinger functions, rather than generic proof nodes.
Separate kinematics from dynamics: OS positivity and reconstruction build the Hilbert-space language, while decay, clustering, and nontriviality must express the dynamics of the gauge theory.
Connect Euclidean data to spectral meaning through the spectral measure of time correlations and say what support away from zero would physically exclude.
State same-theory transfer: the continuum object, reconstructed Hamiltonian, observable algebra, nontriviality witness, and gap witness must be outputs of one limiting theory.
Describe failure physically: cutoff leakage, finite-volume artifacts, Gaussian collapse, loss of reflection positivity, or an observable family too small to see the excitation spectrum.
Turn each strategic move into a mechanism-bearing lemma with assumptions, equations, observables, limit regime, and a disqualifying counter-scenario.

story_beats.decision: Keep this as the mathematical endpoint and derivation checkpoint, but do not promote it as the primary proof route.

equations.label: Hamiltonian endpoint

equations.display: Spec(H restricted to P_perp H_YM) subset [Delta, infinity), Delta > 0
equations.label: Mass-gap form

equations.display: E_H((0, Delta)) P_perp = 0
equations.label: Equivalent spectral projection exclusion

story_beats.headline: First we tried to express the goal as a bounded Hamiltonian spectral-gap subclaim.
story_beats.moved_to: Euclidean correlator decay plus OS/transfer machinery, because it offers a possible witness for the Hamiltonian spectral lower bound.
story_beats.physics_story: This is the clean energy-spectrum formulation of the Clay target. Once Euclidean Yang-Mills has produced OS-positive Schwinger functions, reconstruction should give the physical Hilbert space of gauge-invariant states, the vacuum vector, time translations, and a positive Hamiltonian. A mass gap means that after removing the vacuum line there are no arbitrarily soft physical excitations: the first glueball-like gauge-invariant energy lies at least Delta above the vacuum.
story_beats.tried: Use a bounded Hamiltonian spectral-gap route endpoint claim only after stating which reconstructed Yang-Mills objects and observables make it meaningful: Use the Hamiltonian formulation as the endpoint check: after the physical Hilbert space, vacuum, and time-translation generator are reconstructed from the same continuum Yang-Mills data, prove that vacuum-orthogonal excitations have energy at least a strictly positive Delta.
what_we_learned: We learned that Hamiltonian language is indispensable as an endpoint test but weak as a discovery engine unless the reconstruction inputs are already available.
A claimed gap must always be asked backwards: where did H_YM, Omega, H, P_perp, and the observable algebra come from?
This converted the analysis from naming a desired spectral inequality into tracking the Euclidean construction and reconstruction prerequisites that make the inequality meaningful.
why_it_did_not_pay_off: This did not pay off as a proof route because it described the endpoint more than the construction mechanism.
X: the Hamiltonian formulation presupposes the reconstructed continuum Hilbert space rather than constructing it.
Y: the key inequality E_H((0,Delta)) P_perp = 0 is the hard mass-gap lemma itself, so naming it does not discharge it.
Z: a fixed-lattice transfer-matrix gap may disappear as the cutoff is removed, and gauge-invariant observables may fail to determine the full excitation spectrum.

story_beats.decision: Keep this route in the active proof queue, but require uniformity and spectral-determining observables before treating it as progress.

equations.display: <O(t)O(0)>_c = integral_0^infinity exp(-t lambda) d mu_O(lambda)
equations.label: Spectral representation pressure

equations.display: supp(mu_O) subset [m, infinity) for a spectrally determining family O
equations.label: Gap inference target

story_beats.headline: Then we moved to Euclidean correlator decay as a spectral-gap witness.
story_beats.moved_to: Balaban/RG continuum control, because correlator decay is not enough unless it survives into the same continuum object.
story_beats.physics_story: This is the Euclidean physics face of a gap. If a gauge-invariant observable O creates physical excitations from the vacuum, its connected Euclidean time correlation is a Laplace transform of the Hamiltonian spectral measure seen by O. Exponential decay with a cutoff-independent rate says that this spectral measure has no weight near zero. The route is physically meaningful only if the observables survive the continuum limit and are rich enough to see the vacuum-orthogonal excitation sector.
remaining_blockers: The decay constants must be uniform through cutoff removal.
The selected gauge-invariant observables must be dense or spectrally determining in the vacuum-orthogonal sector.
The reconstructed theory must remain nontrivial and interacting.
story_beats.tried: Test the Euclidean spectral mechanism: gauge-invariant Schwinger-function correlations must decay with cutoff-uniform rates, reflection positivity must reconstruct the physical Hilbert space, and the corresponding spectral measures must have support bounded away from zero in the vacuum-orthogonal sector.
what_paid_off: It connects directly to the Hamiltonian endpoint through spectral representation.
It exposes concrete observables and decay constants rather than only an abstract spectral claim.
It tells the monitor what a mass-gap witness would look like in Euclidean data.
what_we_learned: Correlator decay is valuable only when it is a same-theory spectral witness: the observables, OS reconstruction, and Hamiltonian must all come from the same limiting Schwinger functions.
The right mathematical object to demand next is not just a decay estimate, but a cutoff-uniform decay-to-spectrum lemma with an observable-density hypothesis.
This taught the loop to treat strong-coupling lattice decay as evidence-task material until it carries a continuum-transfer certificate.
why_it_did_not_pay_off: It did not pay off as a standalone proof route because Euclidean decay can be true in a regulated or strong-coupling regime without proving a continuum Yang-Mills mass gap.
It left two hidden assumptions exposed: the decay constants must not vanish under cutoff removal, and the observable family must determine the whole physical excitation spectrum.
It also did not by itself supply nontriviality; an exponentially decaying sector is not enough if the limiting theory is Gaussian, empty, or not the constructed Yang-Mills object.

story_beats.decision: Keep this route in the active proof queue as the construction spine.

equations.display: S_{a,L}(A) -> S_YM^cont as a -> 0 and L -> infinity
equations.label: Cutoff-removal spine

equations.display: sup_k ||R_k||_{B_k} < infinity with nontrivial interacting remainder
equations.label: Uniform control demand

equations.display: S_n^{(a,L)} => S_n, with S_n satisfying reflection positivity
equations.label: OS-positive limit target

story_beats.headline: In parallel we moved to Balaban RG as the continuum-construction spine.
story_beats.moved_to: Fuse RG continuum control with correlator-decay/spectral transfer rather than treating them as separate successes.
story_beats.physics_story: This is the scale-dynamics side. Starting with regulated gauge fields, the RG analysis must show that integrating out short-distance modes does not lose control of the non-Abelian interaction, does not break the gauge-invariant observable algebra, and has a continuum limit as the lattice spacing goes to zero and the volume goes to infinity. For the Clay problem, ultraviolet stability is not yet the explanation of the gap; it is the condition under which there is a nontrivial continuum vacuum whose correlations could carry a gap.
remaining_blockers: RG stability alone is not a mass gap.
The limiting object must satisfy OS/Wightman adequacy.
A mass-gap witness must be extracted in the same limiting theory rather than imported from a regulated model.
story_beats.tried: Test the Balaban renormalisation-group mechanism: scale-by-scale control of regulated non-Abelian gauge fields must survive ultraviolet cutoff removal as a non-Gaussian, OS-positive continuum Yang-Mills object, and that same object must still supply a gauge-invariant spectral witness for the mass gap.
what_paid_off: It addresses the four-dimensional continuum-limit bottleneck directly.
It gives a place to ask for nontriviality witnesses in the limiting Yang-Mills object.
It can potentially feed the correlator-decay route with cutoff-stable estimates.
what_we_learned: Balaban-style control should be used as the construction spine, not as a substitute for the mass-gap mechanism.
The decisive test is whether RG-controlled cutoff objects produce OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions and a non-Gaussian same-theory witness.
This shifted the loop toward an RG-to-OS bridge lemma instead of adding more renormalisation vocabulary.
why_it_did_not_pay_off: It did not pay off as a mass-gap route by itself because ultraviolet/RG stability is not the same thing as an infrared spectral threshold.
It still leaves the OS/Wightman bridge open: a controlled effective action sequence must produce Schwinger functions with the axioms needed for reconstruction.
It can falsely look like progress if the loop celebrates multiscale control while never extracting a gauge-invariant decay or spectral witness.

story_beats.decision: The next iteration should produce explicit bridge-lemma packets, not another broad slogan.

equations.display: RG control + OS positivity + uniform clustering => Delta_YM > 0
equations.label: Bridge lemma skeleton

equations.display: (S_n, H_YM, H, Omega) must be reconstructed from the same limiting theory
equations.label: Same-theory constraint
equations.latex: (S_n,\mathcal H_{\mathrm{YM}},H,\Omega)\ \text{must be reconstructed from the same limiting theory}

story_beats.headline: Now the recursive strategy is to fuse construction and spectral transfer.
story_beats.moved_to: OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions plus gauge-invariant spectral-determining observables.
next_recursive_questions: Which exact Schwinger functions or Wilson-loop/local-curvature observables are candidates for decay estimates?
Can Balaban-style bounds imply any uniform clustering or decay input, or is a separate infrared argument required?
What density theorem for gauge-invariant observables would make decay-to-gap transfer legitimate?
story_beats.physics_story: The bridge has to say how a continuum gauge theory constructed by scale control becomes a spectral statement. The same limiting Schwinger functions must satisfy reflection positivity, define the gauge-invariant observable algebra, retain a non-Gaussian connected sector, and have Euclidean time correlations whose spectral measures avoid a neighborhood of zero. Only then can the reconstructed Hamiltonian inherit a positive lower threshold.
story_beats.tried: Use OS reconstruction as the kinematic bridge: produce reflection-positive Yang-Mills Schwinger functions, reconstruct Wightman fields and Hamiltonian time evolution, then ask whether a same-theory gauge-invariant spectral witness excludes arbitrarily light excitations.
what_we_learned: The analysis should now advance by testing typed bridge lemmas, not by accumulating more route families.

A strategy only counts as learning if it changes the mathematical dependency order: Hamiltonian claims move behind reconstruction gates, decay claims move behind uniformity/density gates, and RG claims move behind OS/nontriviality gates.
The next useful artifact is therefore a bridge-lemma packet with definitions, assumptions, equations, failure tests, and conditional skill triggers.
why_this_is_the_next_goal: It keeps the continuum object, OS reconstruction, nontriviality witness, and Hamiltonian gap in the same theory.
It prevents drift into pure Hamiltonian notation without construction.
It prevents drift into lattice-only decay without continuum spectral meaning.

story_beats.decision: Keep all three reductio branches active as proof-obligation pressure tests, not as proof results.

equations.display: for all epsilon > 0, exists psi_epsilon in P_perp H_YM with ||psi_epsilon||=1 and <psi_epsilon,H psi_epsilon> < epsilon
equations.label: No-gap negated world
equations.valid_when: H_YM, Omega, H, and P_perp are reconstructed from the same OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions.

equations.display: sum_i,j conjugate(c_i)c_j S(Theta f_i,f_j) < 0
equations.label: OS-failure negated world
equations.valid_when: The f_i are reflected gauge-invariant test observables in the limiting Schwinger-function algebra.

equations.display: <O_1 ... O_k>_c = 0 for the witness family
equations.label: Triviality-collapse negated world
equations.valid_when: The O_i are gauge-invariant observables in the same continuum object used for reconstruction and gap analysis.

story_beats.headline: We then added reductio branches to test whether the negated worlds create real mathematical pressure.
story_beats.physics_story: A reductio is physically useful only when the negated world leaves a detectable trace. If there is no gap, there should be a sequence of vacuum-orthogonal gauge-invariant states with energies tending to zero, or equivalently spectral weight accumulating at the origin for some determining observable family. If OS positivity fails, the Euclidean theory cannot reconstruct a positive-norm quantum Hilbert space. If the continuum limit is trivial, connected gauge-invariant cumulants collapse. These are physical failure modes, not just logical negations.
remaining_blockers: Audit exact negation and same-theory preservation before proof-queue promotion.
Attach every contradiction branch to a certification artifact and demotion trigger.
Keep all reductio carriers inside the reconstructed continuum Yang-Mills object.
story_beats.tried: Assume the structured negations that matter for Yang-Mills: OS positivity fails, the continuum limit collapses to triviality, or the reconstructed Hamiltonian has no positive gap.
what_paid_off: The reductio branches expose carrier objects instead of slogans: spectral mass, reflection forms, and connected cumulants.
They make backtracking precise: if the conflict cannot be made same-theory, the route is quarantined rather than celebrated.
They turn failure into learning by naming whether density, closedness, nontriviality, or cutoff-uniformity is the missing hinge.
what_we_learned: The loop learned to use contradiction as a disciplined pressure test rather than an excuse to skip construction.
A branch succeeds only if the contradiction target is accepted or validator-backed in the same theory.
A failed branch is still valuable when it tells us whether to pivot toward density, closedness, nontriviality, or uniform-decay evidence.
why_it_did_not_pay_off: No contradiction branch currently proves Yang-Mills; each branch is only promotable as a proof obligation.
The no-gap reductio still depends on observable density and cutoff-uniform decay.
The OS and triviality reductios still depend on closedness of reflection positivity and a same-theory nontriviality witness.

abstraction_chain.interpretation: The best machinery is not a single method; it is the ordered chain that lets construction, representation, invariants, transfer, witness, and validation act on one target object.

nodes.object: A nontrivial four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 for a compact simple gauge group G, satisfying OS/Wightman adequacy and a strictly positive Hamiltonian mass gap in the reconstructed physical theory.
nodes.why_needed: The machinery must preserve the exact problem rather than solve a nearby regulated, lower-dimensional, or heuristic proxy.

nodes.object: Regulated compact-simple Yang-Mills gauge-field ensemble with ultraviolet cutoff and infrared volume control.
nodes.why_needed: Construction machinery needs a source object whose limits can be analyzed without losing gauge structure.

nodes.object: Continuum gauge-invariant Schwinger functions S_n for observables such as Wilson-loop or local curvature-composite families.
nodes.why_needed: Schwinger data are the Euclidean representation on which OS reconstruction and correlator decay can act.

nodes.object: Gauge invariance, OS positivity, Euclidean covariance, nontrivial connected sector, and same-theory identity.
nodes.why_needed: These invariants prevent the chain from changing the theory while passing through limits and reconstructions.

nodes.object: Reconstructed physical Hilbert space H_YM, vacuum Omega, Hamiltonian H, and gauge-invariant observable algebra.
nodes.why_needed: Hamiltonian spectral claims are meaningful only after Euclidean data transfer into a positive-energy quantum theory.

nodes.object: Cutoff-uniform Euclidean decay or spectral-measure support away from zero for a spectrally determining observable family.
nodes.why_needed: The mass gap needs a witness that excludes arbitrarily soft non-vacuum excitations in the reconstructed theory.

nodes.object: Spec(H on P_perp H_YM) subset [Delta, infinity) for some Delta > 0 in the same nontrivial theory.
nodes.why_needed: This is the final Clay mass-gap commitment after construction, reconstruction, nontriviality, and witness transfer are certified.

role_alignment.construction: RG and multiscale control act from regulated gauge fields to continuum Schwinger data.
role_alignment.invariant_preservation: Gauge invariance, reflection positivity, nontriviality, and same-theory identity must survive every arrow.
role_alignment.representation: Schwinger functions represent the Euclidean theory in a form that reconstruction and decay estimates can inspect.
role_alignment.transfer: OS reconstruction transfers Euclidean data to Hilbert-space spectral semantics.
role_alignment.validation: Same-theory and cutoff-uniform checks certify that the final gap belongs to the Clay target.
role_alignment.witness: Euclidean decay and spectral measures witness the absence of low-energy non-vacuum excitations.

assumptions_required: regulated compact simple gauge-field objects are defined
uniform multiscale estimates are available
reflection positivity or a route to OS positivity is preserved
items.controlled_interface: regulated gauge-field measures or effective actions -> continuum Schwinger-function object
items.example_alignment: Yang-Mills: Balaban-style RG is construction machinery for the continuum object, not the final gap witness.
invalid_use_modes: Treating finite-volume or small-field RG control as continuum construction.
Counting ultraviolet stability as an infrared mass gap.
Losing gauge invariance or OS positivity in the limit.
items.machinery_needed_because: The target cannot be reached by a spectral endpoint until a same-theory continuum object exists.
items.machinery_not_yet_allowed: Do not use RG control itself as a mass-gap proof without a same-theory spectral witness.
items.output_obligation: Produce a continuum Yang-Mills Schwinger-function family with nontrivial gauge-invariant observables.
items.required_bridge_obligation: RG-to-OS bridge lemma with topology, limiting objects, positivity preservation, and nontriviality witness.

acceptable_weakenings: Euclidean OS-first construction is acceptable only when reconstruction, nontriviality, continuum limit, and positive mass-gap obligations remain explicit.
Regulated or lattice formulations are acceptable only as source objects for a certified continuum-transfer bridge.
forbidden_nearby_problems: A fixed-lattice or finite-volume mass gap without cutoff-removal transfer.
A lower-dimensional or scalar proxy theory without a same-target transfer theorem.
A perturbative ultraviolet statement treated as nonperturbative construction.
Numerical glueball or lattice spectroscopy evidence used as theorem authority.

policy.purpose: Choose mathematical and conceptual machinery by the proof role it controls.

roles.construction: Builds the target object or a regulated approximation that can be transferred to it.
roles.invariant_preservation: Keeps essential commitments unchanged across transformations.
roles.obstruction: Explains why a naive route fails and what must be repaired.
roles.representation: Gives the target object a tractable mathematical form.
roles.transfer: Moves information between regimes, formalisms, limits, or reconstructed objects.
roles.validation: Checks that the route proves the intended target rather than a nearby proxy.
roles.witness: Produces a detectable property that would certify the target claim.

policy.title: Abstraction And Machinery Selection Policy

machinery_selection.purpose: Explain why each mathematical abstraction is being used now: which proof role it plays, which interface it controls, what invalid uses are blocked, and how the abstraction chain moves from target object to final claim.

summary.portfolio_read: A coherent long-horizon portfolio needs construction, transfer, witness, and validation roles to connect the target object to its final claim.

machinery_selection.title: Machinery Selection
universal_role_read: Construction is valuable when the target object is not yet built.
Representation is valuable when the object exists but cannot yet be reasoned over.
Invariant preservation is valuable when transformations risk changing the problem.
Transfer is valuable when meaning must cross a regime, limit, or formalism.
Witness machinery is valuable when the final claim needs a detectable certificate.
Obstruction machinery is valuable when a route fails and the failure can teach the next bridge.
Validation machinery is valuable when local success might solve a proxy instead of the target.

control_policy: Restrategize when a route remains target-relevant but the current formulation hides the real missing lemma.
Backtrack when a step achieved apparent progress by importing an object from the wrong theory, cutoff, volume, or reconstruction stage.
Pivot when a route repeatedly fails its own certification tests while another route preserves more essential commitments with fewer hidden assumptions.
Quarantine when a route is interesting but cannot yet preserve existence, nontriviality, OS/Wightman adequacy, continuum limit, and positive mass gap in one theory.
Deepen rather than pivot when the obstruction is a missing bridge lemma whose source and target objects are already correctly identified.
reorientation_control.current_diagnosis: Physically, the active routes are not competing stories about different problems. They are two incomplete views of one Yang-Mills mechanism. The Balaban/RG route asks whether the non-Abelian gauge-field ensemble can be controlled from the ultraviolet cutoff to a non-Gaussian continuum vacuum with reflection-positive Schwinger functions. The correlator route asks whether gauge-invariant observables in that same vacuum have Euclidean time spectral measures whose support stays away from zero, which would exclude arbitrarily light physical excitations after reconstruction. Neither view is disposable: RG without an infrared spectral witness constructs no gap, while decay without continuum object identity and observable density may only describe a regulated or too-small sector. The correct next motion is a bridge-focused restrategy that proves or falsifies same-theory transfer across cutoff removal, OS reconstruction, nontriviality, and spectral support.

current_recommendation.pivot_guard: Pivot only after the relevant physical obstruction has repeated under certification: no continuum object, no reflection positivity, no nontrivial connected sector, no observable density, or no cutoff-uniform spectral lower bound.
current_recommendation.quarantine_guard: Strong-coupling lattice decay, lower-dimensional analogies, and numerical glueball evidence remain evidence tasks until they state the transfer certificate connecting them to the same continuum Yang-Mills object.
current_recommendation.rationale: Do not pivot away from the current routes merely because the mathematical obstruction is hard. The live physical question is whether scale-controlled gauge-field construction can feed a Euclidean spectral measure argument in the same continuum theory. The honest move is to type that bridge: source objects, observable algebra, limiting regime, spectral measure, and disqualifying failure modes.

reorientation_control.purpose: Give the long-horizon loop a reflective mechanism for restrategize, backtrack, and pivot decisions in physics terms. The aim is not to move because the search feels stuck; it is to diagnose whether the obstruction concerns construction of the continuum gauge-field measure, reconstruction of the quantum Hilbert space, nontriviality of the vacuum sector, or the infrared spectral support of gauge-invariant excitations. Current Diagnosis states the physical obstruction; Current Recommendation states the licensed move; Bounded Reflection prevents endless meta-looping; Route-Level diagnosis binds every control decision to a concrete route; each mode names a Forbidden Shortcut that would create false progress.

certification_evidence: Observable is defined in the same limiting continuum object.
Connected or higher-order correlation does not vanish in the limit.
The witness distinguishes the result from a free Gaussian fixed point.
disqualifiers: The witness is only heuristic or simulation-level evidence.
The observable is not gauge invariant.
The nontriviality claim comes from a different approximation scheme than the constructed limit.

promotion_policy: Do not mark achieved from notation, route ranking, or successful report generation.
Mark potential_breakthrough_signal only when the certification evidence is attached to the same continuum Yang-Mills object.
Demote immediately if the result lives only at fixed cutoff, in finite volume, or in a theory that is not the reconstructed target theory.
success_milestones.purpose: Signpost the big-deal mathematical achievements that would change the status of the Yang-Mills run. A milestone is not proof completion; it becomes a potential breakthrough only when it is potentially achieved by attached certification evidence and its disqualifiers have been actively checked. Each card names a success signal, certification evidence, disqualifier tests, and a next action.

target_object_contract.exact_target_object: A nontrivial four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 for a compact simple gauge group G, satisfying OS/Wightman adequacy and a strictly positive Hamiltonian mass gap in the reconstructed physical theory.
forbidden_nearby_problems: A fixed-lattice or finite-volume mass gap without cutoff-removal transfer.
A lower-dimensional or scalar proxy theory without a same-target transfer theorem.
A perturbative ultraviolet statement treated as nonperturbative construction.
Numerical glueball or lattice spectroscopy evidence used as theorem authority.
A Hamiltonian spectral statement whose Hilbert space, vacuum, or observable algebra is postulated rather than reconstructed.
